name: hero-data-flow
title: Hero data flow
description: Animated data streams for scrape and answer demos.
usage: A product page hero's `background`, around its demo. It runs through the element marked with the anchor attribute, or a Hero's HeroMedia, and draws nothing where the sides are too narrow.
avoid: A data flow and a dot field in one hero
A data flow without a demo in the middle

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
